Help & Tips
🚀 Getting Started ▾

Daily View: Your home base. See what's due today and mark things done.

Manage Blocks: View all your activities regardless of when they're due.

Calendar: See upcoming events and add one-time activities.

💡 Key Concepts ▾

📋 Blocks: Activities you want to do regularly. Each block has a name, frequency, optional timer, and more.

🏷 Sections: Organize your day into Morning, Afternoon, Evening, and Night. Reorder blocks and move them between sections.

🔄 Frequencies: Daily (every day), Weekly (specific days), Biweekly (every 2 weeks), Monthly (specific date), or One-off (calendar events).

⏱ Timers: Countdown (fixed duration), Stopwatch (track time spent), or None. Countdown timers show time remaining; stopwatch tracks cumulative time.

⭕ Optional Blocks: Activities that don't affect your streak if skipped. Good for "nice to have" tasks.

↩ Rollover: Incomplete blocks can roll over to the next day (enable in block editor). Great for flexible tasks.

✨ Features ▾

📁 Subsections: Create nested groups within sections for better organization. Add from the + button on section headers in Daily view.

📅 Calendar Events: One-time activities pinned to specific dates. Add from Calendar tab or set frequency to "Once" in the editor.

⊘ Inactive Blocks: Temporarily hide blocks without deleting them. Find them at the bottom of Manage Blocks.

🔥 Streaks: Complete all required (non-optional) blocks to maintain your daily streak. View stats at the top of Daily.

🌙 Start Times: Optionally set when a block should happen. Shows time badges and enables notifications (if enabled in Settings).

💫 Tips & Tricks ▾

📊 Info Strip: The auto-scrolling ticker at the top shows weather, sky info, and astrology. Hover over it to pause and manually scroll through modules. Enable/disable items in Settings → Info Strip.

⚙ Gear Menus: Tap the ⚙ icon on any block to access quick actions: reorder with ↑↓ arrows, edit details, or delete. The menu stays open after moving blocks.

🎨 Themes: Try all 9 themes! Autumn & Sunset are warm and cozy, Cosmic & Electric are vibrant, Minimal & Mono are clean, Earthy & Jungle are natural, Journal is classic. Each has light/dark modes.

📂 Subsections: Group related blocks together (e.g., "Morning Routine" → Shower, Coffee, Vitamins). Reorder subsections and blocks independently. Collapse subsections to declutter.

📅 Calendar Workflow: Use Calendar view for one-time events and future planning. Blocks appear in Daily view on their scheduled date. Reorder calendar items within each day.

🔄 Rollover Strategy: Enable rollover for flexible tasks that can carry over (e.g., "Read for 30 min"). They'll show with a ↩ badge the next day if incomplete.

⏱ Timer Tips: Countdown timers are great for focused work sessions. Stopwatch mode tracks cumulative time across days (perfect for projects). Toggle "Track total" to see lifetime hours.
